content: {"summary":"On 16 Mar 2025 a partner integration saw TLS failures on about one‑third of calls; edge‑gateway‑01 had near‑zero traffic because it kept an expired certificate after renewal, caused by a manual pod‑restart that missed that pod.","likely_cause":"Manual pod‑restart procedure deleted/restarted the wrong pods, leaving edge‑gateway‑01 un‑restarted and thus still using the old certificate loaded at startup.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Partner integration reported TLS failures on roughly one third of its calls on 16 Mar 2025.","evidence_ids":["INC-0023#0"],"quote":"partner integration reports TLS failures on about a third of its calls since around 10:15."},{"text":"Edge‑gateway‑01 saw near‑zero request rate while the other two pods handled traffic.","evidence_ids":["INC-0023#0"],"quote":"request rate for edge-gateway-01 has been close to zero since 10:15 and the other two pods picked up the difference."},{"text":"Edge‑gateway‑01 was presenting an expired certificate while the other pods presented the renewed one.","evidence_ids":["INC-0023#1"],"quote":"edge-gateway-01 presents a certificate whose notAfter is 2025-03-16 10:15 UTC."},{"text":"The pod missed restart because the manual delete sequence restarted the same pod twice, leaving the original pod untouched.","evidence_ids":["INC-0023#1"],"quote":"the name at the top was the replacement created by the first delete, so that pod was restarted twice"},{"text":"Envoy reads the certificate files only at startup; a secret renewal takes effect only after a pod restart (e.g., rollout restart).","evidence_ids":["RB-025#0"],"quote":"Envoy reads those files when it starts, so a renewed Secret takes effect only after `kubectl ... rollout restart`."}],"next_checks":["Verify with `openssl s_client` that all edge‑gateway pods now serve the renewed certificate.","Ensure future certificate renewals use `kubectl rollout restart` rather than manual pod deletions.","Add per‑pod certificate verification to the monitoring probe to catch stale certs early.","Confirm that request rates on all edge pods return to normal and no TLS failures are observed."]}
